items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: that club that Ed Small had over there for about a couple of months.

ctx.x: See, I didn't think to call him up and say come. (Inaudible) I say, 'Oh heck, I'm not -- these guys don't want me. I'm going back to Philly.'

When I got back to Philly, he called me. He say, 'Where you at?' I say, 'I'm home.' 'Will you come on back, we're waiting for you?' So the next day I came back, and I worked over at 5th Avenue, that club that Ed Small had over there for about a couple of months.
It was like a private club. Then he moved me over to Small's Paradise. And I worked with Charlie Johnson there for about a year.
